name: Danzai no Elmyr
source:
The half-elf Emilia came down to the human village in search for medicine for her father.
However, she was taken into the church basement and imprisoned, where she was
teased, trained, and violated.
After humans, orcs, and tentacles enjoy her body, you will ultimately decide her fate...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ047914.html]DLsite English[/url]]
